evidence.detail: R344 TitlePaneControlPanel constructs rs/gui/P with itself and installs it as its sole LayoutManager.
The class implements LayoutManager2, computes a compact single-row preferred/min/max size from component count, and lays each child horizontally with fixed 23px cells and vertical centering.
The layout stores only its synthetic TitlePaneControlPanel reference; all add/remove/invalidate hooks are no-ops and it owns no unrelated launcher state.

candidates.note: Descriptive exact-v308 name for the compact layout manager used only by TitlePaneControlPanel.
